utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m relieved the boxes and tape are set, but until someone confirms screws and gloves, I’d rather we plan as if Noah’s toolbox won’t cover us.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That makes sense—before we plan around supplies, can we confirm the date and location for the repair drive, and whether screws and gloves are actually covered?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, let’s pin down the date and location first, and I still want a clear yes-or-no on who’s bringing screws and gloves before we count on any of it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll be there a little before nine with the ladder and tool kit, and I can help set up when I arrive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect—keep 12 Maple and 18 Oak on the list, and we should still have someone else cover tape, screws, and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good—I’ll stick with the ladder and tool kit and get there a little before nine to help set up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Vik, I’m passing along firm confirms and any tool or spare-part gaps to Mara, so if you know what you can bring for the repair drive, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still telling everyone the plan is to meet by the community shed, but attendance and supplies are still a little up in the air. I’ll pass along anything firm I can bring as soon as I know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’s helpful, Vik—once you know what’s firm, send it my way and I’ll make sure Mara gets the update for the list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Uli, Rosa’s still confirming the final start time tonight, but I’ve already got the tape, markers, and boxes set aside at the community shed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Cleo. I can bring a few basic tools and stop by for a bit if I’m able, though I may need to head out early.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’d help, Uli—bring what you can, and I’ll pass along Rosa’s final start time as soon as she confirms it tonight.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help spread the word, but I’m still waiting on Opal’s confirmed details so I don’t send people the wrong info.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, that’s what I figured—I’d been hearing around 9, but let’s wait for Opal’s confirmation before anyone plans around it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Exactly—I’m ready to reach out to the church group, block watch, and school pickup parents as soon as Opal confirms the time and the rest of the details.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces, so I’m not sure if it’s locked in for this weekend—Jules or Sam probably know for sure.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Rosa’s finalizing the schedule now, so it sounds close; if you want, I can point you to her for the latest details.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, I’d appreciate that—I’ve mostly been hearing things second-hand, so I’d rather check with Rosa before I plan anything.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m in to help, Eli, but Opal’s got the schedule details—want to check with her while I head to Maple Street first?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works, Sam—please head to the community shed on Maple, and I’ll have Opal confirm the schedule details while we keep Saturday’s plan in order.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good—I’ll head to the community shed on Maple now, and once Opal confirms the schedule, I’ll jump in wherever I’m needed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I came in late too, but I did hear it’s Sunday at the community center now, not Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, that helps—Sunday at the community center could work for me if we keep it between school pickup and drop-off needs, but can you confirm what time it starts and whether the van can be prioritized?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can’t confirm the start time or the van yet—I only heard the update that it moved to Sunday at the community center, so we should check with Hana or Jules for the specifics.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Opal—that helps a lot. Keep sending folks to Maple Street for now, and if Sam changes the plan, let me know and keep spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Will do—I’m still directing everyone to Maple Street for the fence panels, and I’ll let you know as soon as Sam reports any shift.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks, Opal—I’ll keep pulling in more hands too, so just keep everyone headed to Maple Street until we hear otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Still no firm update on my end—last I heard, we’re planning to meet by the community shed, so text me if anything gets urgent and I’ll head over.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the shed. I’ll try to bring the toolbox over in a bit, and I’ll text if I get turned around again.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, thanks—bring it by if you can, and if plans firm up or it turns urgent, just text me and I’ll come over.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Mina, I’m still matching people to slots, so if you’ve got any firm availability or supply gaps, send them my way and I’ll fold them into the repair drive plan.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How many people are firmly confirmed right now, and what supply gaps still need covering?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: A few are firm, but I’m still waiting on the latest confirms and the tool and spare-part gaps before I give you a clean count—send me anything definite you’ve got, and I’ll add it right in.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oren, can you confirm who’s actually organizing the repair drive and whether the exact start time is 10, not 9?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, I can’t confirm that yet—I’m still fuzzy on the details, so I should check with Vik before I say whether it starts at 10 or who’s organizing it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, please check with Vik and let me know who’s leading it and whether the start time is definitely 10 before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Rosa, I’m helping Mara round up firm confirms and any tool or spare-part gaps for the repair drive—have you heard who’s definitely coming or what we might still need?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess — definitely let Mara know the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, and please send me any firm confirms plus tool or spare-part gaps so I can coordinate the rest.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thanks, Rosa—I’ll pass along that it’s Sunday at the community center, and I’ll keep gathering firm confirms and any tool or spare-part gaps so you and Mara can coordinate the rest.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oren, are you definitely in for this weekend, and do you know the actual confirmed headcount yet?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m definitely in to help, but I don’t want to guess on the headcount since I still need Hana to confirm the details.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Fine—you're in, but I need a real number, not a maybe; when will Hana confirm the headcount?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good, but I still want Mara’s confirmation before we count on Noah’s toolbox—if screws and gloves aren’t covered, we need a backup plan.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll still be there around nine with my ladder, drill, and tool kit, so we’ve got a decent backup if Noah gets delayed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That does make me feel better, Gus, but I still want Mara to confirm the screws and gloves before we call the setup covered.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Rosa’s organizing the repair drive, and I’ve got the tape, markers, and boxes set at the community shed; I’m still checking on screws and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Good to know—we’re still at the community shed, then; text me if Rosa locks in anything urgent and I’ll head over.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Will do—I’m keeping an eye on supplies here, and as soon as Rosa confirms anything urgent, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara, I’m happy to help pull people in from different circles—I’m just waiting on the confirmed date, place, and repair list so I don’t spread mixed details.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules—that’s exactly right; I’m still locking down the confirmed date, place, and repair list, and I’ll send you the firm details as soon as I have them so you can start pulling people in.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks, Mara—I’ll hold off on inviting folks until your confirmed update comes through, then I can help spread the word cleanly.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m in for the repair drive, Noah—Opal’s handling the schedule, but once we’ve got the time I’m ready to help wherever I’m needed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—good, thanks, Sam. I think Gus is still coming a little before nine with his ladder, and I’m supposed to bring the toolbox if I don’t get turned around.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good—I’ll plan to be there ready to pitch in, and we can confirm the exact timing with Opal so we’re all lined up.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry, I’m coming in late—Rosa told me it’s Sunday at the community center now, but Opal, do you have the latest details for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yeah—the crew’s first stop is still the fence panels on Maple Street, and I’m sending folks there unless Sam reports back with a change.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—Sunday at the community center, and first stop’s the Maple Street fence panels unless Sam changes it. Thanks, I’ll help pass that along.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Rey, before we say anything else about the repair drive, can you confirm the date, exact location by the shed, and whether van brake work is actually included or just the small fixes?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I only know we’re starting around nine by the shed and keeping the list to small fixes like bikes, lamps, and toasters; I’d check with Rosa for the exact date and whether van brake work is included.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Rey—that’s helpful; before we tell anyone else, I’ll check with Rosa to confirm the exact date, the precise shed location, and whether van brakes are actually included.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, van brakes first makes sense—I’m just waiting on Opal to pin down the exact time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo—I can make it work as long as we schedule around school drop-off and pickup, so once Opal confirms the time, send it over.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Will do—I’ll skim Opal for the time and send it over as soon as I’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Before I say yes, can you confirm who’s actually organizing it and whether the start time is really 10 by the community shed?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yep—it’s me organizing it, and yes, we’re starting at 10 by the community shed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, if it’s definitely you and it’s definitely 10 at the community shed, I can stop by for a bit—but can you text me if anything changes?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces from Mara, so I’m not totally sure either—maybe Jules would know if it’s definitely still on this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I think it’s still happening, but I’m only planning to stop by briefly if I can. Mara or Jules probably knows the details better than I do.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, that tracks with what I’ve been hearing too—I’ll check with Jules before I bring anything over.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: As far as I’m telling people, we’re still meeting by the community shed for the repair drive, and I’ll pass along any firm updates as soon as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds right—I'd still tell folks to bring tape, screws, and gloves just in case Noah gets delayed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, that’s the plan I’ve been repeating too—meet by the community shed, and I’ll keep telling people to bring tape, screws, and gloves just in case.
